## Checklist

- [ ] CI ran on this PR's head commit: both `verify` checks show and pass. Zero checks means CI did not run; do not merge

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] Every configured `eval:*` command passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
